description_en: Modifies the private network traffic diversion limit, execution time configuration, or automatic access state for newly added network interface controller (NIC) of a specified VPC
description_zh: 修改指定 VPC 的私网引流流量上限、执行时间配置或新增网卡自动接入状态
name: UpdatePrivateTractionAttributes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC instance
parameters.name: vpc_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The upper limit of private network traffic diversion, in GB. The value must be greater than 0 or equal to -1. A value of -1 indicates no limit. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 私网引流流量上限，单位为 GB。取值必须大于 0 或等于 -1，-1 表示不限制。不传时保持原值
parameters.name: max_traffic

parameters.help_en: The traffic diversion time configuration. The format is start time, end time, day of the week, and day of the month in sequence. The start time and end time use the HH:mm format. Fixed start and end times or periodic configurations are supported. For example, 00:00 23:59 * * indicates execution all day every day. The day of the week and the day of the month cannot be specified at the same time. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 引流时间配置，格式依次为开始时间、结束时间、星期和日期，其中开始时间和结束时间使用 HH:mm 格式。支持固定起止时间或周期配置，例如 00:00 23:59 * * 表示每天全天执行。星期与日期不能同时限定。不传时保持原值
parameters.name: time_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically connect subsequently added network interface controller (NIC) to the VPC. A value of true indicates that the feature is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled. If this parameter is not specified, the original status is retained. After the feature is disabled, automatic connection for newly added network interface controller (NIC) stops, and the access state of existing network interface controller (NIC) remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动接入该 VPC 后续新增的网卡。true 表示开启，false 表示关闭。不传时保持原状态。关闭后停止自动新增接入，已有网卡的接入状态保持不变
parameters.name: auto_access

AutoAccess.description_en: The automatic access state for newly added network interface controller (NIC) of the VPC after the operation is completed. A value of true indicates that the feature is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
AutoAccess.description_zh: 操作完成后该 VPC 的新增网卡自动接入状态。true 表示已开启，false 表示已关闭
AutoAccess.title_en: 修改后的自动接入状态
AutoAccess.title_zh: 修改后的自动接入状态
